description:
U.S. Customs and Border Protection (CBP) is conducting market research for Tower Climbing Training & Equipment.  This is a Request for Information (RFI) released pursuant to Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) Part 10 - Market Research.  This RFI's purpose is to obtain market information on viable sources, industry practices, answers to specific questions, and industry comments relating to the attached full RFI.

Attached:

  • Request for Information
  • Draft - Statement of Work
